title: Whale Tail Wall Hook
description: Wall hook whose peg ends in a whale tail fluke. The 2-screw plate has countersunk holes.
use: Light-duty hook for keys, hats, headphones, a light jacket (design target about 1 kg - untested). Screw to wall or use strong double-sided tape.
material: PETG, 0.2 mm layers, 4+ perimeters, 50%+ infill. Print plate-flat as shown (peg rises vertically). Screws: #6 / 3.5 mm flat head.
